newsitem.title: UKRAINE: TABLE-Ukraine 6-mo T-bill yields steady, rest fall.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Ukraine 6-mo T-bill yields steady, rest fall.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of six-month Ukraine treasury bills remained the same, while nine-month, 12-month and 18-month treasury bills edged down from the last sales, a central bank said on Thursday.

Six-month bills remained at 20.13 percent, nine-month bills fell to 27.52 percent from 27.70 percent, 12-month bills slipped to 29.16 percent from 29.65 percent and 18-month bills eased to 32.42 from 32.45 percent.
The results of the six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 22.00 million UAH 18.50 million UAH
Amount sold 6.29 million UAH 17.27 million UAH
Actual amount raised 5.72 million UAH 15.69 million UAH
The central bank sold 62,909 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 29.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 20.00 million UAH 16.00 million UAH
Amount sold 20.00 million UAH 16.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 16.59 million UAH 13.25 million UAH
The central bank sold 200,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 29.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated 47.50 million UAH
Amount sold 137.92 million UAH 47.50 million UAH
Actual amount raised 106.85 million UAH 36.66 million UAH
The central bank sold 1,379,249 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 29.
The results of the 18-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 36.40 million UAH 5.96 million UAH
Actual amount raised 24.51 million UAH 4.01 million UAH
The central bank sold 364,005 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 18-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 29.
